entries.settings: Unsupervised fit per series; detector applied point-wise to raw 1-D values; point-wise AUC-ROC averaged over all 367 YAHOO series

source.title: TSB-UAD: An End-to-End Benchmark Suite for Univariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection (Paparrizos et al.)
source.locator: README 'Overall Results' table, row YAHOO, column LOF (AUC 0.86, F 0.62)

entries.notes: Not apples-to-apples: the groundtruth is TSB-UAD's windowed LOF column, whose reference pipeline uses sliding-window embedding with FFT-based window length and min-max score normalization, while libraryts' PyOD adapter applies LOF point-wise to raw 1-D values (no window embedding, no score normalization) — the dominant source of deviation vs the paper column. The dataset-level protocol does match: libraryts scores the same 367 TSB-UAD series and averages per-series AUC. F1 not compared (TSB-UAD uses a mu+3-sigma threshold on normalized scores; detector thresholds here differ).
entries.train_command: libraryts train --algorithm PyODLOFDetector --dataset tsb-yahoo --model-id bench-detection-lof-yahoo-auc --param contamination=0.1 --param n_neighbors=20

source.locator: Measured 2026-10-15 via `libraryts train/run --algorithm PyODCBLOFDetector --dataset tsb-yahoo` (model probe-cblof10-yahoo); TSB-UAD README 'Overall Results' table has no CBLOF column

entries.notes: TSB-UAD (PVLDB 2022) does not evaluate CBLOF and TSB-AD (NeurIPS 2024) publishes no results for it, so no public per-dataset AUC-ROC exists for these series; the groundtruth is a libraryts baseline measured with this exact pipeline on 2026-10-15. n_clusters=10 instead of the catalog default 8: with 8, pyod CBLOF fails its cluster-separation check on 14/367 YAHOO series. NAB and Genesis are excluded: they contain constant/binary series (NAB_data_art0_1/art0_3, genesis-anomalies.test.csv@17) on which CBLOF cannot form valid clusters at any n_clusters, and libraryts aborts multi-series training on the first failing series. Dodgers is excluded as well: its single series makes the unseeded k-means baseline swing 0.36-0.41 across repeats. k-means is unseeded; three repeat runs of this pipeline spread <=0.012 on the four retained datasets, so tolerance 0.10 is comfortable.
entries.train_command: libraryts train --algorithm PyODCBLOFDetector --dataset tsb-yahoo --model-id bench-detection-cblof-yahoo-auc --param n_clusters=10 --param contamination=0.1

entries.notes: Protocol gap: the paper's K-means (DTW) assigns with DTW (5% Sakoe-Chiba band) but updates centroids with the arithmetic mean, from one random init (their code/Kmeans(DTW)/kmeans.m). libraryts runs tslearn's TimeSeriesKMeans with metric='dtw' (full-window DTW, DBA barycenter update) once with a fixed seed (fit_on=all), with the paper's 15-iteration cap and the DBA barycenter capped at 30 sub-iterations for runtime. Deviations reflect the update-rule/window difference, not a bug.

entries.notes: Deterministic algorithm (no random init): the paper's published scores (Scores/Adjusted Rand Score.csv) match sklearn's AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=k) with its default ward linkage exactly — 40/41 datasets reproduce to machine precision on the raw fused train+test vectors, and libraryts runs the same sklearn implementation through the AgglomerativePanelClusterer wrapper (flattened series, fit_on=all).
